label: UniFi Gateway Max
description: Five 2.5GbE ports and 2.3 Gbps of IDS/IPS throughput, with a 2.5G WAN and four LAN ports. The gateway for a 2.5G access network that needs real inspection.
notes: Vendor figures: 2.5GbE RJ45 x5 (2.5G/1G/100M/10M); IDS/IPS throughput 2.3 Gbps. One port is the WAN and the remaining four are LAN; the ports are assignable, so they are modelled as five symmetric 2.5G interfaces.
